item.title: Stan Johnson Art Gallery expands opportunities for local artists
item.description: After the Anderson-Brickler Gallery closed, a new Black-owned art gallery is keeping the legacy alive, creating space for local artists and inspiring the next generation.

item.title: UPDATE: Tornado Watch canceled for all local areas
item.description: Severe weather risks have cleared out of the remainder of our service area, and the earlier tornado watch has been canceled as a result

item.title: Fire burns near US Highway 129 in Suwannee County
item.description: A fire is burning near US Highway 129 and 170th Terrace in Suwannee County, covering approximately 1.5 acres, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.
